an5.97:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānasatiṃ bhāvento na cirass'eva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati. Katamehi pañcahi? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu appaṭṭho hoti appakicco subharo susantoso jīvitaparikkhāresu, appāhāro hoti anodarikattaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto, appamiddho hoti jāgariyaṃ anuyutto, yāyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā, seyyathīdaṃ appicchakathā . . . pe . . . evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati. Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ānāpānasatiṃ bhāvento na cirass 'eva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhatī ti.
